definitions.explanation: The weight of a person's or animal's body, typically measured in kilograms.

examples.japanese: {体重|たいじゅう}を{測|はか}る。
{最近|さいきん}{体重|たいじゅう}が3キロ{増|ふ}えた。
ダイエットで{体重|たいじゅう}を{減|へ}らしたい。
examples.english: I want to lose weight through dieting.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体重|たいじゅう}を{測|はか}る (to weigh oneself)
- {体重|たいじゅう}が{増|ふ}える (to gain weight)
- {体重|たいじゅう}が{減|へ}る (to lose weight)
- {体重|たいじゅう}を{落|お}とす (to lose weight intentionally)
- {体重計|たいじゅうけい} (scale, weighing machine)

RELATED BODY MEASUREMENTS:
- {身長|しんちょう} (height)
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう} (body fat)
- {体型|たいけい} (body type, figure)

USAGE: In Japan, body weight is measured in kilograms (キロ/kg).
